subject.name: Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters
subject.summary: Plumbers, pipefitters, and steamfitters assemble, install, and repair piping that carries water, steam, air, or gas according to drawings, working with pipe fittings, valves, equipment, and connection points, and checking and recording abnormalities. Pressurized, gas, hot work, and confined space tasks must be carried out according to local regulations, project authorization, and safety procedures; paper exercises do not constitute an operating qualification.
